phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Entrepreneurial Foundations & Self-Discovery — Explore entrepreneurship career pathways, build business literacy, and identify personal strengths.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and entrepreneurship career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to entrepreneurship pathways including venture creation, social enterprise, family business, and intrapreneurship.

milestones.label: Explore the entrepreneurial mindset
milestones.description: Introduction to management principles with emphasis on entrepreneurial thinking, opportunity recognition, and the role of small business in the economy. Students explore entrepreneurial archetypes and startup ecosystems.

milestones.label: Build financial literacy for entrepreneurs
milestones.description: Learn to read and prepare financial statements essential for business planning, investor communication, and financial management of new ventures.

milestones.label: Join Enactus or Entrepreneurship Club
milestones.description: Join NC A&T's Enactus team, Entrepreneurship Club, or startup incubator community. Attend pitch events, connect with student founders, and explore the campus innovation ecosystem.

milestones.label: Analyze economic forces shaping entrepreneurship
milestones.description: Examine how economic conditions, market structures, and regulatory environments create opportunities and barriers for entrepreneurs in local, national, and global markets.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Venture Development & Market Validation — Learn venture creation fundamentals, build marketing skills, and validate business ideas.

milestones.label: Develop a venture concept and business model canvas
milestones.description: Apply the Lean Startup methodology and Business Model Canvas to develop, test, and iterate a venture concept. Students conduct customer discovery interviews and validate product-market fit assumptions.

milestones.label: Master marketing fundamentals for startups
milestones.description: Study marketing strategy, market segmentation, digital marketing, and brand development. Students apply marketing principles to develop go-to-market strategies for their venture concepts.

milestones.label: Compete in campus pitch competition
milestones.description: Develop and deliver a pitch deck for a startup concept in a campus-wide pitch competition. Receive feedback from faculty judges, alumni investors, and local entrepreneurs.

milestones.label: Analyze local startup ecosystem and community assets
milestones.description: Map the Greensboro-Triad entrepreneurship ecosystem including incubators, accelerators, angel investors, and community development financial institutions. Connect classroom learning to the local innovation economy.

milestones.label: Conduct informational interviews with entrepreneurs
milestones.description: Interview three entrepreneurs or small business owners to understand startup challenges, funding strategies, and lessons learned. Synthesize findings into a comparative entrepreneurship report.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Venture Growth & Professional Experience — Build a working business plan, secure mentorship, and gain startup experience.

milestones.label: Write a comprehensive business plan
milestones.description: Develop a comprehensive business plan including market analysis, operations plan, financial projections, and funding strategy. Plans are reviewed by faculty, mentors, and potential investors.

milestones.label: Study venture finance and funding strategies
milestones.description: Learn capital structure, valuation, and financing options for startups including bootstrapping, angel investment, venture capital, crowdfunding, and SBA loans.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with an entrepreneur mentor
milestones.description: Establish a formal mentorship with a successful entrepreneur or small business owner through CoBE networks or local Small Business Development Center. Monthly meetings provide guidance on venture development.

milestones.label: Complete summer entrepreneurship internship or venture launch
milestones.description: Either intern at a startup, venture capital firm, or incubator, or work full-time on launching a personal venture through a structured accelerator program. Document learnings and milestones.

milestones.label: Study social entrepreneurship and impact investing
milestones.description: Explore social enterprise models, impact measurement, and sustainable business practices. Students develop social venture concepts addressing community challenges in the Triad region or developing nations.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Venture Launch & Career Activation — Launch a venture or transition to corporate intrapreneurship, complete capstone.

milestones.label: Execute capstone venture launch or consulting project
milestones.description: Either launch a venture with paying customers and revenue, or complete a strategic consulting project for an early-stage startup. Demonstrate entrepreneurial competency through real-world outcomes.

milestones.label: Complete innovation and design thinking workshop
milestones.description: Intensive design thinking workshop covering rapid prototyping, user testing, and innovation management. Students apply human-centered design to solve real business problems.

milestones.label: Mentor aspiring student entrepreneurs
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in the entrepreneurship track, coaching them through business plan development, pitch preparation, and customer discovery processes.

milestones.label: Develop venture growth or career launch portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble either a venture portfolio (pitch deck, financial projections, customer traction) for investor meetings or a career launch package for corporate innovation and intrapreneurship roles.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Management Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting venture launch status, job offers, or graduate program admissions.
